label: Tier 1 — Primary Authoritative
description: Legislation, official regulators, government publications, official training records and direct documentary evidence where appropriate.

label: Tier 2 — Professional or Institutional
description: Professional bodies, institutional materials and reports with identifiable governance or accountability.

label: Tier 3 — Secondary Analysis
description: Secondary analysis, commentary or synthesis dependent on underlying primary material.

label: Tier 4 — Practitioner or Contextual
description: Practitioner accounts, contextual material and case information that may inform but not replace primary evidence.

label: Tier 5 — Unverified or Discovery Only
description: Unverified or discovery-only material not suitable for verified public claims.
